newsitem.title: USA: American Airlines offers half-price fares.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines offers half-price fares.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines said on Sunday that it and its American Eagle affiliate are offering discounts of up to 50 percent for travel to most 48-state domestic destinations, compared with regular 21-day advance purchase fares.
American said that domestic 48-state discounts are 50 percent for travel through May 5 and 45 percent for travel May 6 through September 6.
Hawaii and Canada discounts are 42 percent through May 5 and 37 percent May 6 through September 6.
The above non-refundable fares will be on sale through April 14.
Discounts for Mexico, Latin America and the Caribbean are 15 percent from April 7 through May 31.
Examples of the round-trip sale prices are Chicago-Boston $238, compared to a regular fare of $513 and Los Angeles-New York for $388, compared to a regular fare of $925.
A spokeswoman for Delta Air Lines Inc said that the airline will most likely be competitive in overlapping markets, but the company would probably not announce a decision until tomorrow.
Spokesmen for UAL Corp, Continental Airlines Inc and Northwest Airlines Corp were not immediately available for comment.
